parameters.name: warehouses
parameters.description: Labels of warehouses indexed by i

parameters.name: ports
parameters.description: Labels of destination ports indexed by j

parameters.name: supply
parameters.description: Available inventory of empty containers at each warehouse

parameters.name: demand
parameters.description: Required container demand at each port

parameters.name: distance
parameters.description: Distance from each warehouse to each port

parameters.name: cost_rate
parameters.description: Transportation cost rate per kilometer per container

parameters.name: truck_capacity
parameters.description: Truck capacity in containers per truck

variables.name: shipments
variables.description: Number of containers shipped from warehouse i to port j

variables.name: trucks
variables.description: Number of trucks deployed on route from warehouse i to port j

variables.name: unused_inventory
variables.description: Number of containers left unused at each warehouse after the plan

constraints.name: supply_balance
constraints.description: Total shipped containers from each warehouse plus unused inventory cannot exceed available supply

constraints.name: demand_satisfaction
constraints.description: Every port demand must be satisfied exactly by incoming shipments

constraints.name: truck_capacity_route
constraints.description: Truck count on each route must be sufficient to carry the shipped containers within capacity

constraints.name: nonnegativity_shipments
constraints.description: Shipment quantities must be nonnegative integers.

constraints.name: nonnegativity_trucks
constraints.description: Truck counts must be nonnegative integers.

constraints.name: nonnegativity_unused_inventory
constraints.description: Unused inventory must be nonnegative integers.

constraints.name: warehouse_inventory_balance
constraints.description: All inventory at each warehouse is either shipped to ports or left unused.

constraints.name: port_demand_satisfaction
constraints.description: Each port demand must be met exactly by incoming shipments.

constraints.name: route_truck_capacity
constraints.description: The number of trucks assigned to a route must be sufficient to carry the containers shipped on that route.

constraints.name: shipment_integrality
constraints.description: Shipment quantities must be nonnegative integers.

constraints.name: truck_integrality
constraints.description: Truck counts must be nonnegative integers.

constraints.name: unused_inventory_integrality
constraints.description: Unused inventory must be nonnegative integers.

constraints.name: integrality_and_nonnegativity_shipments
constraints.description: Shipment quantities must be nonnegative integers.

constraints.name: integrality_and_nonnegativity_trucks
constraints.description: Truck counts must be nonnegative integers.

constraints.name: integrality_and_nonnegativity_unused_inventory
constraints.description: Unused inventory must be nonnegative integers.

constraints.name: supply_nonnegativity
constraints.description: Supply is a nonnegative integer parameter.

constraints.name: demand_nonnegativity
constraints.description: Demand is a nonnegative integer parameter.

constraints.name: distance_nonnegativity
constraints.description: Distances are nonnegative real parameters.

constraints.name: cost_rate_nonnegativity
constraints.description: Transportation cost rate is a nonnegative scalar parameter.

constraints.name: truck_capacity_positivity
constraints.description: Truck capacity is a positive scalar parameter.

objectives.name: transportation_cost_minimization
objectives.description: Minimize total transportation cost for shipping containers from warehouses to ports

final_objective.description: Minimize total transportation cost for all shipped containers, using the per-container route cost \(\rho\,\ell_{ij}\) multiplied by shipment quantity \(x_{ij}\).
